walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Religious Studies specification.

An Introduction to Philosophy of Religion appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet An Introduction to Philosophy of Religion in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with An Introduction to Philosophy of Religion.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
